Head of Product — Consumer Finance, London hybrid.

Orbit Money (London, 450 people, Series D) runs a consumer finance app with savings, cards and loans. We're hiring a Head of Product who will directly manage our twelve product managers and four product designers, own the product P&L and sit on the exec team as general manager of the consumer business. Hybrid, two days a week in London. Experience running a product org of this size, with budget and hiring authority, is essential.
